subject.title: Feature Request: Inline media display in chat (images, audio, video, web previews)

question: What Control UI media rendering policy should core support for untrusted chat content: same-origin/data/blob only, proxied opt-in remote previews, or direct remote embeds?
rationale: Current code and docs intentionally block arbitrary remote image fetches, while the issue asks for richer previews that would change operator-browser privacy and content-security boundaries.

options.title: Keep safe default, split narrow fixes
options.body: Preserve same-origin/data/blob defaults, land narrow first-party image rendering fixes, and require explicit maintainer design before remote previews or autoplay behavior.

options.title: Approve proxied opt-in previews
options.body: Allow richer previews only through a server-mediated or user-consented path with CSP, docs, tests, and browser proof updated together.

options.title: Allow direct remote embeds
options.body: Accept third-party browser fetch and tracking tradeoffs and update renderer, sanitizer, CSP, docs, and live proof as one coordinated change.

recommendation.title: Keep safe default, split narrow fixes
recommendation.body: Preserve same-origin/data/blob defaults, land narrow first-party image rendering fixes, and require explicit maintainer design before remote previews or autoplay behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is closest to the Control UI remote image/CSP boundary this owner changed in merged history.
